title: 第13章 大周云王在此第14章 他想临幸我母后
slug: 绑定全国每人每天给我一两银
lines: 大街上，陆舟一脚踩着袁决，抬眸冷冷看向赶来的官兵，神色泰然。
对面，为首的州兵校尉大惊失色，怒不可遏。
他身为茶州刺史直属部下，此刻见到对方唯一的儿子被这般欺辱，哪里还坐得住。
这名校尉当即气血爆发，猛然朝着陆舟冲来，右手拔出长刀，势要将其劈成两半！
陆舟只淡淡挑眉，岿然不动。
身后，李雄当即跨步上前，腰间佩刀铮然出鞘！
嗡！
浑厚内气骤然爆发，缠裹刀身，清越鸣响震彻长街，引来周围百姓惊讶连连。
锵！
两者相撞，气势轰鸣。
李雄稳稳接住了对方的攻击，腕间猛催内气，沉雄力道轰然迸发，直接将那州兵校尉震得踉跄倒退。
同为校尉，出身京城神武军的他，更胜一筹！
那州兵校尉瞪大双眼，心头剧震。
六品武者！
他再不敢贸然强攻，僵立原地。
恰在此时，大批官军蜂拥而至，瞬间将三人围了起来。
“放开袁少爷！”州兵校尉回过神来，怒声道。
其他官军随即抬矛，指向三人，气势汹汹。
李雄退了回去，与周川护在陆舟左右，眼神冷冽，丝毫不惧。
一群小小的州兵，在他们两名久经沙场归来的人面前，还不够看。
更别说，他们身边这位可是大周王爷！
“放开我……啊！”
被按在地上摩擦的袁决还想挣扎，但陆舟一用力，又让其闭上了嘴巴。
周围百姓，一个个神情错愕，满是震惊。
他们原以为官兵来了，陆舟等人会放了刺史之子。
但看这架势，分明是要硬刚到底！
这几位到底是何方神圣？
场中，陆舟踩着袁决，饶有兴致地看向那名州兵校尉：“我只是在阻止他人犯罪，应该没做错什么吧。”
那校尉神情变幻，咬牙冷哼，声色俱厉地喝断：“哼，你有什么证据证明袁少爷作奸犯科？不过是你一面之词！速速放人，否则休怪本尉刀下无情！”
话音未落，他骤然抬眼，凶光毕露地扫过周遭围聚的百姓。
茶州百姓本就惧怕刺史权势，被这等凶戾威压一慑，瞬间噤若寒蝉。
州兵校尉见状，冷笑连连，正欲再次开口。
“我能作证！”
就在这时，一道突兀的声音陡然响起。
此前被扔出去的张钰竟是不顾家丁劝阻，强行站了出来。
陆舟目光一闪。
这家伙，有点骨气啊。
那州兵校尉没想到有人真敢当众戳穿真相，他顿时恼羞成怒，长刀指向陆舟：“放肆，袁少爷乃是刺史公子，便是有过，也轮不到你们置喙！更轮不到你们三个狂徒动手！”
这话下来，算是彻底不装了，打算仗势压人。
随即他大声下令：“用军阵，将他们统统拿下！反抗者，格杀勿论！”
话音一落，四周士兵手握兵器，迅速落位，齐齐沉腰纳气，体内气血涌动并产生共鸣。
content_en:
On the street, Lu Zhou stepped on Yuan Jue and looked up at the approaching officers and soldiers with a calm expression.
Opposite, the leading state military school captain was shocked and furious.
As a direct subordinate of the Chazhou Governor, he could not sit still when he saw the other party's only son being humiliated like this.
The captain's energy and blood immediately burst out, and he suddenly rushed towards Lu Zhou. He pulled out a long knife with his right hand and was about to cut him in half!
Lu Zhou just raised his eyebrows slightly and remained unmoved.
Behind him, Li Xiong stepped forward immediately, the sword on his waist was unsheathed!
Buzz!
The strong inner energy suddenly erupted, wrapping around the blade, and the sound of Qing Yue shook the long street, attracting surprise from the surrounding people.
Clang!
The two collided and roared with momentum.
Li Xiong caught the opponent's attack steadily, and fiercely activated his inner energy in his wrists. Shen Xiong's strength suddenly burst out, directly shaking the captain of the state military academy and staggering backwards.
He is also a school captain and comes from the Shenwu Army in the capital, so he is even better!
The Nazhou Military Academy captain's eyes widened and his heart was shaken.
Sixth grade warrior!
He no longer dared to attack rashly and stood still.
At this moment, a large number of officers and soldiers swarmed in and instantly surrounded the three people.
"Let go of Master Yuan!" the state military commander came to his senses and said angrily.
The other officers and soldiers immediately raised their spears and pointed them at the three men with fierce momentum.
Li Xiong retreated, guarding Lu Zhou with Zhou Chuan, his eyes cold and unafraid at all.
A group of small state soldiers was not enough to see them in front of two men who had returned from the battlefield.
Not to mention, the person next to them is Prince Zhou!
"Let me go...ah!"
Yuan Jue, who was pressed to the ground and rubbed, still wanted to struggle, but Lu Zhou used force and shut his mouth again.
The people around him all looked stunned and shocked.
They thought that when the officers and soldiers arrived, Lu Zhou and others would release the governor's son.
But looking at this posture, it is clear that he is going to fight to the end!
Who are these people?
In the field, Lu Zhou stepped on Yuan Jue and looked at the state military academy captain with interest: "I was just preventing others from committing crimes. I shouldn't have done anything wrong."
The captain's expression changed, he gritted his teeth and snorted coldly, and shouted in a stern voice: "Hmph, what evidence do you have to prove that Master Yuan committed an adultery? It's just your words! Let him go quickly, otherwise don't blame me for being ruthless!"
Before he finished speaking, he suddenly raised his eyes and glanced at the people gathered around him with a fierce glare.
The people of Chazhou were originally afraid of the power of the governor, so they were frightened by such brutal coercion and fell into silence for an instant.
Seeing this, the state military captain sneered again and again and was about to speak again.
"I can testify!"
At this moment, a sudden voice suddenly sounded.
Zhang Yu, who had been thrown out before, ignored the dissuasion of his servants and stood up forcefully.
Lu Zhou's eyes flashed.
This guy has some backbone.
The Lieutenant of the Military Academy of Nazhou did not expect that someone would dare to reveal the truth in public. He suddenly became angry and pointed his long knife at Lu Zhou: "You are outrageous. Master Yuan is the governor of the province. Even if he has, it is not your turn to comment! It is not your three fanatics' turn to take action!"
After saying this, he stopped pretending at all and planned to use his power to suppress others.
Then he loudly ordered: "Use military formations to capture them all! Anyone who resists will be killed without mercy!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the surrounding soldiers held weapons in their hands and quickly took their positions. They all lowered their waists and took in the Qi, and the Qi and blood in their bodies surged and resonated.
title_en: Chapter 13 King Yun of the Great Zhou Dynasty is here Chapter 14 He wants to visit my mother
